title: The same question at the coffee counter
question: A DoorDash customer says an item was missing from order 100660 on Tuesday. What do I do?
expected: Ridgeline has no order 100660 and is not on any delivery marketplace. The answer says both, instead of borrowing the noodle house's rule or inventing one.

trace.question: A DoorDash customer says an item was missing from order 100660 on Tuesday. What do I do?
trace.answer:
I couldn't find order 100660 in your data, and your written policies don't cover missing items on DoorDash orders.

Two searches of the policies, one for missing-item disputes and deadlines and one for marketplace order issues, both came back empty. I don't have a rule to cite for who approves a refund, how long you have to dispute, or how DoorDash handles it. I won't make one up.

Check that the order number is right. If you can give me the date or the customer, I can look the order up another way. Once you have it, check DoorDash's merchant portal or terms for their dispute process and deadline. I can't file or change anything from here.

detail.sql: select id, created_at AT TIME ZONE (SELECT timezone FROM merchants) as local_ts, channel, source_raw, state, item_count, gross_sales_cents, discount_cents, total_cents from orders where id=100660

SELECT id, created_at AT TIME ZONE (SELECT timezone FROM (SELECT * FROM merchants WHERE id = 2) AS merchants) AS local_ts, channel, source_raw, state, item_count, gross_sales_cents, discount_cents, total_cents FROM (SELECT * FROM orders WHERE merchant_id = 2) AS orders WHERE id = 100660 LIMIT 500
